name: codex-model-router
description: Route bounded Codex subagent work by task complexity and risk.

interface.shortDescription: Route Codex tasks to the right subagent model.
interface.longDescription: Injects routing and worker-contract context so a primary Codex agent can delegate bounded work with an appropriate model and reasoning effort.
defaultPrompt: Break this request into bounded tasks and route suitable work to subagents.
